title: 显存账本
note_on_kind: 标准代码章（非 primer）：走 implementer 精简版 + lint_fidelity 全链。Part IV 第二章——ch13 已把池的内部（块/表/槽位恒等式/引用计数）打开，本章回答池的上一级问题：池多大、谁定的、门多紧。L0 缩放 = KV 账本列+启动（kv_column + boot 两块）。叙事角度按 pedagogy-plan：『profile 三步定账 / 准入门 / 混合注意力组化』三 introduces，notes 给了 #39734 死锁教训作 why 锚。
hook_suggestion: 「ch13 把池立起来了，可这池到底该多大？vLLM 启动先跑一次 dummy 前向，把权重、激活峰、CUDA graph 全称一遍，剩下的才分给 KV——一笔账凭什么一次算清、算少了浪费算多了炸？账定了 num_blocks，请求进门时凭什么担保整条序列装得下——chunked prefill 只查第一块的超收漏洞曾让请求 prefill 到一半装不下死锁（issue #39734），是怎么被一道准入门和『启动定账与运行准入必须同源』的铁律根治的？还有混合模型：一层要全部历史、一层只要个滑窗，一个池子怎么切才不浪费？」（从 Part IV hook『显存就那么多，KV cache 必须活到最后』+ 本章主题『显存账本』+ deepread/memory-kv.json why_chains[1]（三步定账）、why_chains[8]（护栏组合/#39734）、why_chains[6]（混合组化）提炼）
scope_note: 主线 = 账本三问『饼多大 / 怎么切 / 门多紧』：(A) profile 三步定账——request_memory（预算=总显存×util，默认 0.92 per-instance）→ determine_available_memory（memory_profiling 三类显存 + dummy 前向测激活峰 + cudagraph 估计 → available_kv = requested − non_kv − cudagraph）→ get_kv_cache_configs（护栏四道：check_enough 至少装下一条 max_model_len / 二分估可行长度 / auto-fit / override 折算；num_blocks = available // page_size // group_size；PP 取最小）→ 同一份 config 喂调度器（拍平）与 worker（CuMem 池分配），容量/并发写回 cache_config。(B) 准入门——full-ISL 门（scheduler_reserve_full_isl 默认 True：整序列预留，堵 chunked prefill 只查第一 chunk 的超收）+ 回收感知准入上限（SWA/chunked-local 的 max_admission_blocks_per_request 与启动期池大小器单源——#39734 死锁教训：预测器与池大小器漂移=死锁或 mid-prefill OOM）+ 水位（watermark 默认 0 关：decode-heavy 超收→抢占→重 prefill→再抢占的抖动，headroom 换稳定）。(C) 混合注意力组化——KVCacheSpec 每层自报 → get_kv_cache_groups 分组（页大小统一：调大较小块/Mamba pad；组数等量化 padding + 1.5 启发式 + PP 交错分派）→ 张量共享布局（通用 group_size 池每组出一层 / 单组异宽逐层 / packed 重叠只点名）→ resolve_kv_cache_block_sizes（scheduler=LCM / hash=GCD 或 prefix_match_unit）→ 运行期一个 BlockPool + 每组一 manager；SWA 窗外块回收 + null_block 原位占位；worker 侧 MultiGroupBlockTable + map_to_kernel_blocks 细分。边界与邻章分工：池内分页本体/槽位恒等式/引用计数/free 队列归 ch13；链式哈希/前缀命中/LRU 驱逐/块内 CoW 归 ch15；KVConnector 双面契约/P-D/offload 归 ch16；CUDA graph 捕获内景归 ch19；kernel 块大小的后端协商归 ch21；block_table/slot_mapping 的 PAD/CP 深讲归 ch22。前缀缓存在本章只作为 enable_caching 一个布尔出现（哈希机制→ch15）。

stations.what: 快照定预算：init_device 刻意先建 NCCL 再拍显存快照（L372-L382 注释原话 "This ensures NCCL buffers are allocated before we measure available memory"——不然后测出的 available 偏大）→ init_snapshot → request_memory（worker/utils.py:L409-L429）：requested = ceil(总显存×gpu_memory_utilization)，free < requested 直接 raise。预算先于一切

dummy 前向测峰值：memory_profiling 上下文（mem_utils.py:L233-L326）里 profile_run（gpu_model_runner.py:L6433-L6506）以 max_num_tokens 假数据跑一遍真前向+采样；峰值账 non_kv_cache_memory = total_consumed + transient_peak_headroom（L317-L326）——权重/激活峰/NCCL 等 non-torch 全计入，KV 之前的全部债主先还清

差价定可用：CUDA graph 若启用先 profile_cudagraph_memory 估图池（VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS 默认开，envs.py:L295；等价 util 日志 L568-L605 提示 0.92 已含图池账）→ available_kv = requested − non_kv_cache_memory − cudagraph 估计——一行减法定出 KV 池的全部本金

每层自报形状：get_kv_cache_spec 遍历模型 attention 层收 KVCacheSpec（FullAttention/SlidingWindow/ChunkedLocal/Mamba…）；每层每块页物理公式 real_page_size_bytes = 2×block_size×kv_heads×head_dim×dtype（kv_cache_interface.py:L211-L226）——分组与字节换块数的原料都在 spec 里

混合组化：get_kv_cache_groups——uniform 模型全层一组（多数模型）；混合模型按 spec 分桶合并，页大小先统一（L1070-L1132：调大较小层 block_size / Mamba 按状态形状 pad），组数等量化加 padding 层（L1248-L1256 警告 "may waste at most N% KV cache memory"）；--disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager 回退全按 full 分配（L1568-L1589 警告不做省显存优化）

定账与护栏：get_kv_cache_configs——护栏四道（check_enough 至少装下一条 max_model_len L854-L879、不够二分估可行长度 L800-L851、auto-fit max_model_len=-1 L1988-L2049、override 折算不漂账 L2159-L2179）→ num_blocks = available // page_size // group_size（get_num_blocks L993-L1010）→ PP 各 rank 取最小并按比例缩张量（L2210-L2223）→ 容量/并发日志（L2225-L2240）

一份账喂两侧：同一份 KVCacheConfig 是唯一真相——调度器侧 generate_scheduler_kv_cache_config（L1855-L1874）拍平成代表 spec；worker 侧 initialize_from_config（gpu_worker.py:L650-L676）在 CuMem tag="kv_cache" 池内真分配张量；auto-fit 缩了 max_model_len 要 collective_rpc 同步 worker（L311-L313）；num_gpu_blocks/block_size/容量写回 cache_config（L315-L326）——两侧 num_blocks 必须一致，单源即防漂

账本就位：resolve_kv_cache_block_sizes（kv_cache_utils.py:L626-L688：多组时 scheduler_block_size=各组块 LCM、hash_block_size=GCD 或 prefix_match_unit 覆盖、须整除否则回退/报错）→ KVCacheManager(watermark=scheduler_config.watermark)（L289）→ coordinator 装配：一个 BlockPool + 每组一个 manager（kv_cache_coordinator.py:L90-L120），get_manager_for_kv_cache_spec 顺手给 SWA/chunked-local 注入准入上限（single_type:L1861-L1877）

入场过门（full-ISL）：allocate_slots(full_sequence_must_fit=scheduler_reserve_full_isl——默认 True，config/scheduler.py:L130-L134) → kv_cache_manager.py:L472-L488 按整条序列算块对比 free——chunked prefill 只查第一个 chunk 的超收漏洞（#39734 死锁温床）由这道门堵上；回收型 spec 同时夹到准入上限（single_type:L178-L192，铁律注释见机制账 m11）

水位与稳态门：watermark_blocks = watermark × num_blocks（L168-L171，默认 0.0 即关）；只在本步已有调度请求且状态 ∈ {WAITING, PREEMPTED} 时计入（L463-L470——精修版水位，非 v0 全局垫片）；required = 块数+watermark ≤ free − reserved，否则 None（→ ch11 抢占；decode-heavy 抖动机理与复现配置 benchmarks/kv_cache_watermark.sh:L7-L19）

窗外回收与 null 占位：SWA 的 get_num_skipped_tokens = max(0, computed − sliding_window + 1)（L1057-L1083，docstring 自带 ASCII 图）→ remove_skipped_blocks 把窗外整块 free 归池、原位换 null_block——块表第 i 块仍对应第 i×block_size 个 token（docstring 例 [NULL, NULL, block7, block8]），位置对齐不断裂；full attention 基类恒 0 从不回收

worker 多组落地：MultiGroupBlockTable 每 KV 组一张表；分配块大小 ≠ kernel 块大小时 map_to_kernel_blocks（L221-L248）细分——32-token 内存块拆 2×16 kernel 块（gpu_model_runner.py:L7644-L7651 注释举 256→4×64 例）；张量按 config 的 shared_by 跨组共享（get_kv_cache_config_from_groups 通用分支 L1411-L1437：每池由每组各出一层）——账本块号与 kernel 视图在此对齐

stations_note: 站号 = 账本从诞生到把门的过程顺序：第 1-4 站是启动期一次性测量（快照定预算 → dummy 前向测峰值 → cudagraph 估计差价 → 每层自报 spec）；第 5-8 站是定账与装配（组化 → 护栏+定块数 → 一份账喂两侧 → 账本就位）；第 9-10 站是运行期请求入场要过的两道门（full-ISL 准入门 → 水位门——门的所有预算参数都来自启动账本，运行期不再重算）；第 11-12 站是运行期账本的动态面（SWA 窗外回收+null 占位、worker 侧多组/kernel 细分落地）。正文按讲解需要编排——建议先立『饼多大』（profile 三步）再立『门多紧』（准入门+水位），混合组化可作第三幕；#39734 死锁教训作为门的 why 锚点贯穿。

key_classes.name: MemorySnapshot / MemoryProfilingResult / memory_profiling
key_classes.responsibility: 显存测量的三件套：快照（torch 峰值/已分配/空闲/total/non-torch 六类读数）、profile 结果（non_kv_cache_memory = total_consumed + transient_peak_headroom）、上下文管理器（前测/跑 profile_run/后测/算差）。docstring 自带 1GiB/2GiB/0.5GiB 三类显存量级例。

key_classes.name: Worker.request_memory / determine_available_memory / initialize_from_config
key_classes.responsibility: 账本的 worker 侧三步：request_memory 定预算（total×util，free 不足 raise）；determine_available_memory 跑 profile_run + cudagraph 估计出 available_kv 字节；initialize_from_config 按 config 在 CuMem tag="kv_cache" 池内分配张量并把 num_blocks 写回 cache_config。

key_classes.name: KVCacheSpec 家族（AttentionSpec/FullAttentionSpec/SlidingWindowSpec/ChunkedLocalAttentionSpec/MambaSpec…）
key_classes.responsibility: 每层注意力的自报形状：页物理公式 real_page_size_bytes = 2×block_size×kv_heads×head_dim×dtype；回收型 spec（SWA/chunked-local）带 max_admission_blocks_per_request——启动池大小与运行准入的单一事实源。spec 是组化与字节换块数的全部原料。

key_classes.name: get_kv_cache_groups / unify_kv_cache_spec_page_size / _get_kv_cache_groups_uniform_page_size
key_classes.responsibility: 混合组化：按 spec 分桶（可 merge 的同型层合桶）、页大小统一（调大较小块/Mamba 状态 pad/stride pad）、组数等量化（padding 层+1.5 启发式+PP layers[i::num_groups] 交错）；六条假设 docstring 是一池共享的硬约束清单。disable 回退 unify_hybrid_kv_cache_specs 把 SWA 当 full 分配。

key_classes.name: get_kv_cache_configs / get_kv_cache_config_from_groups / get_num_blocks
key_classes.responsibility: 定账总控：合并全 worker spec → 分组 → override 折算 → auto-fit → 逐 worker 护栏（_check_enough + 二分估长）→ 出 KVCacheConfig（张量布局三型：通用 group_size 池/单组异宽逐层/packed）→ PP 取最小缩张量 → 容量/并发日志。get_num_blocks 的 //page//layers 是字节换块数的总算术。

key_classes.name: KVCacheConfig / KVCacheGroupSpec / KVCacheTensor
key_classes.responsibility: 账本的产物与传递形态：num_blocks（池块数）、kv_cache_groups（每组=同 spec 层名表+merged spec）、kv_cache_tensors（哪几层共享哪块张量+size/offset/block_stride）。一份 config 双喂：调度器侧 generate_scheduler_kv_cache_config 拍平，worker 侧按张量布局分配。

key_classes.name: resolve_kv_cache_block_sizes
key_classes.responsibility: 定两个对齐粒度：scheduler_block_size（多组=各组块 LCM，num_computed_tokens 对齐不变量）与 hash_block_size（GCD 或 prefix_match_unit 覆盖；无缓存/无 connector 或 mamba 非 align 时回退 scheduler 粒度）。

key_classes.name: KVCacheManager（水位）
key_classes.responsibility: 对调度器的门面 + 本章的两道门：watermark_blocks = watermark×num_blocks（L168-L171）；allocate_slots 的 full-ISL 门（L472-L488）与 required ≤ free−reserved−watermark 判定（L510-L527）。

key_classes.name: KVCacheCoordinator / get_manager_for_kv_cache_spec
key_classes.responsibility: 装配形态：一个 BlockPool + 每组一个 SingleTypeKVCacheManager（get_manager_for_kv_cache_spec 按 spec 类型查注册表；SWA/chunked-local 构造时注入准入上限——运行期门与启动期定账的同源装配点）。

key_classes.name: SlidingWindowManager（窗外回收）
key_classes.responsibility: 每层类型自知历史的账本落点：get_num_skipped_tokens = max(0, computed − window + 1)；remove_skipped_blocks 把窗外整块 free 归池、原位换 null_block 保块表位置对齐（[NULL, NULL, block7, block8]）。

key_classes.name: BlockTable / MultiGroupBlockTable / map_to_kernel_blocks
key_classes.responsibility: worker 侧多组落地：每组一张块表；分配块大小≠kernel 块大小时的细分换算（[0,1,2]→[0,1,2,3,4,5]）。kernel 块大小由注意力后端能力决定（协商内景 → ch21）。

key_classes.name: EngineCore._initialize_kv_caches
key_classes.responsibility: 启动装配总编排：收 spec → determine_available_memory → get_kv_cache_configs → auto-fit 同步 → 拍平喂调度器+写回 cache_config → initialize_from_config。单一事实源注释：两侧 num_blocks 必须一致。

why_chains.pain: 被卡的指标是活性（不崩溃）与并发利用率的平衡：门太松死锁、太紧浪费容量。
why_chains.solution: ① full-ISL 准入门：allocate_slots 先按整序列算块数对比空闲块（含水位），不够直接 None 拒之门外（kv_cache_manager.py:L472-L488；scheduler_reserve_full_isl 默认 True，vllm/config/scheduler.py:L130；传入 scheduler.py:L982）。② 回收感知准入上限：SWA/chunked-local 的 admission cap = cdiv(window-1+max_in_flight_tokens, block_size)+1，与启动期池大小器同源（vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py:L522-L546、L587-L608 docstring「Single source of truth for both startup pool sizing and the runtime admission gate」；运行时应用于 get_num_blocks_to_allocate 的 apply_admission_cap，single_type:L179-L191）。③ 新块清零：调度器每步 drain 新块 id（take_new_block_ids kv_cache_manager.py:L796-L801 → scheduler.py:L1260-L1272 _get_new_block_ids_to_zero，含 async-load 覆写区跳过集合 _skip_zero_block_ids L1043-L1052），worker 用 KVBlockZeroer 清零，理由注释原话「to prevent stale NaN/data from corrupting attention or SSM computation」（gpu_model_runner.py:L1219-L1222）；加载失败区补登记 record_blocks_for_zeroing（start_token 必须块对齐，kv_cache_manager.py:L817-L829）。④ CoW 拷贝管线：kv_cache_block_copies 跨进程到 worker 原地拷贝（gpu_model_runner.py:L1223-L1228）。⑤ 1% 采样驻留指标（vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_metrics.py:L46-L96：块生命周期/空闲时长/复用间隔，驱逐时落账；access_history 限长 4）。

def request_memory(init_snapshot: MemorySnapshot, cache_config: CacheConfig) -> int:
    """
    Calculate the amount of memory required by vLLM, then validate
    that the current amount of free memory is sufficient for that.
    """
    requested_memory = math.ceil(
        init_snapshot.total_memory * cache_config.gpu_memory_utilization
    )

    if init_snapshot.free_memory < requested_memory:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Free memory on device {init_snapshot.device_} "
            f"({format_gib(init_snapshot.free_memory)}/"
            f"{format_gib(init_snapshot.total_memory)} GiB) on startup "
            f"is less than desired GPU memory utilization "
            f"({cache_config.gpu_memory_utilization}, "
            f"{format_gib(requested_memory)} GiB). Decrease GPU memory "
            f"utilization or reduce GPU memory used by other processes."
        )

    return requested_memory

def get_num_blocks(
    vllm_config: VllmConfig,
    num_layers: int,
    available_memory: int,
    page_size: int,
) -> int:
    """
    Get the number of kv cache blocks.

    Args:
        vllm_config: The global VllmConfig
        num_layers: The number of layers
        available_memory: Memory available for KV cache in bytes.
        page_size: The page size of the KV cache.
    """
    num_blocks = int(available_memory // page_size // num_layers)
    num_blocks = max(num_blocks, 0)
    return may_override_num_blocks(vllm_config, num_blocks)

    available_memory: int,
    get_needed_memory: Callable[[], int],
    max_model_len: int,
    estimate_max_model_len: Callable[[int], int],
):

        raise ValueError(
            "No available memory for the cache blocks. "
            "Try increasing `gpu_memory_utilization` when initializing the engine "
            "(this flag also controls CPU memory reservation on the CPU "
            "backend, despite its name). "
            "See https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/configuration/conserving_memory/ "

            f"({max_model_len}), ({format_gib(needed_memory)} GiB KV "
            f"cache is needed, which is larger than the available KV cache "
            f"memory ({format_gib(available_memory)} GiB). {estimated_msg}"

# Save the original max_model_len to restore after estimation
    original_max_model_len = vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len

    # Define a function to check if a given model length fits in memory
    def fits_in_memory(model_len: int) -> bool:
        # Temporarily modify the max_model_len for this calculation
        vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len = model_len
        # Calculate memory needed for the given model length
        memory_needed = max_memory_usage_bytes(vllm_config, kv_cache_spec.values())
        return memory_needed <= available_memory

    try:
        # Binary search for the maximum model length
        left, right = 1, original_max_model_len

        # If even the smallest model length doesn't fit, return 0
        if not fits_in_memory(left):
            return 0

        # Binary search for the maximum model length that fits
        result = 1
        while left <= right:
            mid = (left + right) // 2
            if fits_in_memory(mid):
                result = mid
                left = mid + 1
            else:
                right = mid - 1
        return result
    finally:
        # Always restore the original max_model_len to avoid side effects
        vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len = original_max_model_len

To simplify the implementation, we make the following assumptions:
    1. Physical memory per block: Must be the same across all KV cache groups.
    Breaking this assumption is non-trivial due to memory fragmentation concerns
    when allocating blocks of different sizes.
    2. Tokens per block (block_size): Currently, we directly use
    `CacheConfig.block_size` for all layers. It can be extended to vary by KV
    cache group, but within each KV cache group, all layers must share the same
    block size.
    3. Physical memory per token per layer: This property is decided by model
    config. Currently we only support models that have the same physical memory
    per token per layer for all layers. Can be relaxed with a simple extension,
    but still need to keep physical memory per block the same for all groups.
    4. Number of layers per group: Currently assumed the same for all layers.
    Can be relaxed with a simple extension, but still need to keep physical
    memory per block the same for all groups.
    5. Attention type within groups: All layers in a group must share the same
    attention type. One exception is that, when
    `--disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager` is true, the single group for full
    attention layers may also include attention layers using sliding window or
    LLaMA 4 local attention. See `unify_hybrid_kv_cache_specs` for more details.
    6. Support for multiple attention types: The design for most components is
    general to an arbitrary number of attention types. But
    `find_longest_cache_hit` only supports one attention type or two
    types of full-attention plus exactly one another type. The general
    implementation of this function is feasible but we don't know how to
    implement it cleanly yet.

    number of layers per group are the same now, we can ensure that physical

    # strategy if we want to support more complex patterns (e.g., 20 full + 30

        # too many padding layers. A typical example is gpt-oss-20b + eagle,

def resolve_kv_cache_block_sizes(
    kv_cache_config: KVCacheConfig,
    vllm_config: VllmConfig,
) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Resolve (scheduler_block_size, hash_block_size).

    - ``scheduler_block_size`` is the token-alignment invariant used by the
      scheduler (e.g. for ``num_computed_tokens`` rounding). Single group:
      ``cache_config.block_size * dcp``. Multiple groups: LCM of every
      group's effective block size. Attention groups are scaled by DCP;
      Mamba groups keep their full per-rank state and are not scaled.
    - ``hash_block_size`` is the granularity at which ``Request.block_hashes``
      is computed. Single group: equals scheduler block size. Multiple groups:
      ``cache_config.prefix_match_unit`` override if set, else the GCD of
      group block sizes; every group's block size must be divisible by it.
      Returns the scheduler block size (i.e. disables finer hashing) if block
      hashing is inactive or a mamba group's block size diverges from the
      cache block size (mamba_cache_mode != "align").
    """
    cache_config = vllm_config.cache_config
    dcp = vllm_config.parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size
    groups = kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups

    if len(groups) <= 1:
        bs = cache_config.block_size * dcp
        return bs, bs

    group_block_sizes = [
        g.kv_cache_spec.block_size * dcp
        if isinstance(g.kv_cache_spec, AttentionSpec)
        else g.kv_cache_spec.block_size
        for g in groups
    ]
    scheduler_block_size = math.lcm(*group_block_sizes)

    # Block hashes are only consumed by prefix caching and KV connectors
    # (P/D, offloading); when neither is active, keep hash_block_size equal
    # to the scheduler block size.
    connector_enabled = vllm_config.kv_transfer_config is not None
    if not (cache_config.enable_prefix_caching or connector_enabled):
        return scheduler_block_size, scheduler_block_size

    # Mamba groups with block_size != cache_config.block_size
    # (mamba_cache_mode != "align") break divisibility; back off to the
    # scheduler block size.
    if any(
        isinstance(g.kv_cache_spec, MambaSpec)
        and g.kv_cache_spec.block_size != cache_config.block_size
        for g in groups
    ):
        return scheduler_block_size, scheduler_block_size

    requested = cache_config.prefix_match_unit
    hash_block_size = (
        requested if requested is not None else math.gcd(*group_block_sizes)
    )
    if any(bs % hash_block_size != 0 for bs in group_block_sizes):
        raise ValueError(
            f"Invalid prefix_match_unit={hash_block_size}; all KV cache group "
            f"block sizes must be divisible by prefix_match_unit. "
            f"Got group block sizes={group_block_sizes}."
        )
    return scheduler_block_size, hash_block_size

def max_admission_blocks_per_request(
        self, max_in_flight_tokens: int, max_model_len: int
    ) -> int:
        """Per-request admission cap, in blocks.

        Single source of truth for both startup pool sizing
        (`max_memory_usage_bytes`) and the runtime admission gate. Per-request
        real-held blocks plateau at this bound because
        `SlidingWindowManager.remove_skipped_blocks` runs from `allocate_slots`
        before each chunk's `get_num_blocks_to_allocate`.

        `max_in_flight_tokens` is the max tokens scheduled but not yet settled
        (one batch per concurrent step); see `VllmConfig.max_in_flight_tokens`.
        """
        # During chunked prefill, we hold KV for the last `sliding_window-1`
        # computed tokens plus the in-flight tokens (frees happen on the
        # processed-token basis); never more than `max_model_len`.
        num_tokens = min(self.sliding_window - 1 + max_in_flight_tokens, max_model_len)
        # +1 because the sliding window may not start from the beginning of
        # the block. E.g. block size 4 and num_token 4 needs two blocks
        # [XXCD][EF] to store the 6-token window [CDEF].
        return cdiv(num_tokens, self.block_size) + 1

    def max_memory_usage_bytes(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> int:
        assert vllm_config.parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size == 1, (
            "DCP not support sliding window."
        )
        max_blocks = self.max_admission_blocks_per_request(
            max_in_flight_tokens=vllm_config.max_in_flight_tokens,
            max_model_len=vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len,
        )
        return max_blocks * self.page_size_bytes

def remove_skipped_blocks(
        self,
        request_id: str,
        processed_computed_tokens: int,
        num_prompt_tokens: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """
        Remove and free the blocks that are no longer needed for attention computation.
        The removed blocks should be replaced by null_block.

        This function depends on `get_num_skipped_tokens`, which need to be implemented
        differently for each attention type.

        Args:
            request_id: The request ID.
            processed_computed_tokens: Computed-token prefix length covering
                fully processed and committed tokens only (safe to free).
            num_prompt_tokens: Optional prompt length for attention types (e.g.
                R-SWA) that evict a middle gap rather than a head prefix. Ignored
                by the default implementation.
        """
        del num_prompt_tokens
        # Remove the blocks that will be skipped during attention computation.
        num_skipped_tokens = self.get_num_skipped_tokens(processed_computed_tokens)
        if num_skipped_tokens <= 0:
            # This indicates that ALL tokens are inside attention window.
            # Thus we do not need to free any blocks outside attention window.
            # A typical case is full attention that we never free any token
            # before the request is finished.
            return
        blocks = self.req_to_blocks[request_id]
        num_skipped_blocks = num_skipped_tokens // self.block_size
        # `num_skipped_tokens` may include tokens that haven't been allocated yet
        # (e.g., when the attention window moves into the external computed tokens
        # range), so we must cap to the number of blocks that currently exist for
        # this request.
        num_skipped_blocks = min(num_skipped_blocks, len(blocks))
        self._remove_blocks_in_range(request_id, 0, num_skipped_blocks)

def get_num_skipped_tokens(self, num_computed_tokens: int) -> int:
        """
        Get the number of tokens that will be skipped for attention computation.

        For sliding window, this corresponds to the tokens that are prior to
        the current sliding window.

        Example:
        sliding_window=4, num_computed_tokens=7

        Tokens:   [ 0  1  2  3  4  5  6  7 ]
                  | ---- computed -----|
                                         ^ next token to be computed
                               |-----------| sliding window for next token
                  |--skipped---|

        The current window contains tokens 4~7. Tokens 0~3 will be skipped for
        attention computation since they are outside the sliding window.
        Thus, get_num_skipped_tokens(7) == 4.

        Args:
            num_computed_tokens: The number of tokens that have been computed.

        Returns:
            The number of tokens that will be skipped for attention computation.
        """
        return max(0, num_computed_tokens - self.sliding_window + 1)

@staticmethod
    def map_to_kernel_blocks(
        kv_manager_block_ids: np.ndarray,
        blocks_per_kv_block: int,
        kernel_block_arange: np.ndarray,
    ) -> np.ndarray:
        """Convert kv_manager_block_id IDs to kernel block IDs.

        Example:
            # kv_manager_block_ids: 32 tokens,
            # Kernel block size: 16 tokens
            # blocks_per_kv_block = 2
            >>> kv_manager_block_ids = np.array([0, 1, 2])
            >>> Result: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

            # Each kv_manager_block_id maps to 2 kernel block id:
            # kv_manager_block_id 0 → kernel block id [0, 1]
            # kv_manager_block_id 1 → kernel block id [2, 3]
            # kv_manager_block_id 2 → kernel block id [4, 5]
        """
        if blocks_per_kv_block == 1:
            return kv_manager_block_ids

        kernel_block_ids = (
            kv_manager_block_ids.reshape(-1, 1) * blocks_per_kv_block
            + kernel_block_arange
        )

        return kernel_block_ids.reshape(-1)

# Reproducible demonstration of the KV cache watermark (`--watermark`) for
# reducing preemption thrashing.
#
# The watermark is the fraction of total KV cache blocks the scheduler keeps
# free when admitting a waiting/preempted request into the running queue.
#
# Why this workload triggers thrashing:
#   Requests are admitted based on the KV cache they need *at admission time*.
#   With `--scheduler-reserve-full-isl` (default) the input length is reserved up
#   front, but the *output* length is unknown and unreserved. A decode-heavy
#   workload (output >> input) at high concurrency therefore over-admits while
#   requests are short, then runs out of KV cache as they all grow during decode
#   -> the scheduler preempts (recompute) recently-admitted requests, re-prefills
#   them later, and repeats. The watermark keeps a block of KV cache free so
#   running requests can grow into it instead of triggering this churn.
#
# This script launches `vllm serve` under a deliberately KV-constrained config
# and a decode-heavy workload, sweeping the watermark across several values, and
# reports the preemption count (scraped from /metrics), throughput, and latency
# percentiles for each. It then plots the results.
#
# Default workload: concurrency 200, input ~300 tokens, output ~4000 tokens
# (+/- 20% variance), sized to run each config for ~5 minutes.

theory: 每 token KV 显存公式：per_token = 2(K,V) × L 层 × kv_heads × head_dim × dtype_bytes。计算例（非源码断言，deepread 卡口径）：Llama-2-7B FP16 = 2×32×32×128×2B = 524288B ≈ 0.5MB/token；每层每 token = 16KB。『显存是主角』的量化起点。

块数换算 worked example：block_size=16（DEFAULT_BLOCK_SIZE，config/cache.py:L47），Llama-7B 每层每块页 = 16×16KB = 256KB（real_page_size_bytes）。若 profile 出 available_kv = 8GiB、全 attention 单组 group_size=32 层：num_blocks = 8×2^30 // 262144 // 32 = 1024 块；池容量 = 1024×16 = 16384 token；max_model_len=4096 时最大并发 ≈ 1024 / cdiv(4096,16)=256 = 4 条（get_max_concurrency_for_kv_cache_config 的算法，kv_cache_utils.py:L937-L959）。

回收感知准入上限推导：SWA 稳态每请求实持 = 窗口内 + 在途 = cdiv(sliding_window−1+max_in_flight_tokens, block_size)+1。+1 的块内错位：块大小 4、窗口 6 token [CDEF] 需两块 [XXCD][EF]（kv_cache_interface.py:L604-L608 注释原例）。单源铁律的不等式（single_type:L183-L186 注释）：remove_skipped_blocks 每拍先跑 ⇒ 每请求峰值实持 ≤ cap ⇒ sum(预约) ≤ pool ⇔ sum(峰值实持) ≤ pool——启动期与运行期用同一个方法算 cap，漂移即 #39734 死锁或 mid-prefill OOM。

水位经济学：准入时信息缺口——输入长度有 full-ISL 门预留，输出长度未知不预留。decode-heavy（output≫input）高并发：短时超收 → 集体增长 → 池尽 → 抢占刚准入者 → 重 prefill → 再抢占（benchmarks/kv_cache_watermark.sh:L7-L19 官方论证；复现配置并发 128、input ~1000、output ~5000、KV ~1.5×均值需求）。headroom = watermark×num_blocks 空闲不接客，换 running 请求有处可长；默认 0.0 关闭——吞吐换稳定，交给用户按负载调。

LCM/GCD 对齐：多组时调度对齐粒度 scheduler_block_size = lcm(各组 block_size)（num_computed_tokens 必须对所有组的块边界对齐）；哈希粒度 hash_block_size = gcd 或 prefix_match_unit 覆盖（每组块大小都必须整除它，否则 ValueError，kv_cache_utils.py:L682-L687）。计算例：组块 16 与 32 → scheduler=32 / hash=16；mamba 非 align 模式破坏整除性 → 回退 scheduler 粒度（L671-L676）。

等量化组 padding 的浪费上界：组大小 = 各类型层数的最小值（开源混合模型均为 n:1 模式，FIXME 注释 L1238-L1244）；层数比 < 1.5 时取 max 免得 padding 过多（12 SW+13 full → 13/13 而非 12/24，L1248-L1256）；浪费 ≤ padding层数/组内层数，warning 原话「may waste at most N% KV cache memory」（L1261-L1265）。

二分估可行长度的正确性：fits(len) = max_memory_usage_bytes(len) ≤ available 随 len 单调不减（每层 KV 只增不减）→ 标准 upper-bound 二分 O(log max_model_len)；auto-fit 在各 worker 投影组上分别二分取最小（limiting worker，L2016-L2025），全程 try/finally 恢复原值。

一份账两侧一致性的结构保证：get_kv_cache_configs 是唯一产出 KVCacheConfig 的地方（engine/core.py:L304-L306 单点调用）；调度器侧拿 generate_scheduler_kv_cache_config 拍平版（UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs 任取代表层）、worker 侧按 kv_cache_tensors 布局分配；PP 取最小 num_blocks（L2210-L2223）保证各 rank 相同——调度器与所有 worker 看到的 num_blocks 永远相等，靠结构而非运行时对账。

mechanisms.name: 启动三步定账：request_memory（预算）→ determine_available_memory（profile 差价）→ get_kv_cache_configs（字节换块数）——饼有多大一次算清
memory_profiling 三类显存与峰值账：non_kv_cache_memory = total_consumed + transient_peak_headroom（权重/激活峰/非 torch 全计入）
CUDA graph 内存估计入账：profile_cudagraph_memory 估图池 + VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS（默认开，等价 util 日志）——图池吃 KV 预算
护栏四道：check_enough（至少装下一条 max_model_len）+ 二分估可行长度 + auto-fit（max_model_len=-1）+ override 折算 + PP 取最小缩张量
混合组化 get_kv_cache_groups：spec 分桶可合并 / 组数等量化（padding 层 + 1.5 启发式 + PP layers[i::n] 交错）/ disable 回退不省显存
页大小统一 unify_kv_cache_spec_page_size：调大较小层 block_size / Mamba 状态 pad / stride pad——每组每块物理字节相等的硬约束（六条假设）
张量共享布局三型：通用 group_size 池每池各组出一层（一个 block_id 同时刻只归一组）/ 单组异宽逐层各一 / packed 重叠别名
resolve_kv_cache_block_sizes：scheduler_block_size=各组块 LCM（对齐不变量）/ hash_block_size=GCD 或 prefix_match_unit（整除校验；无缓存或 mamba 非 align 回退）
一份账喂两侧：generate_scheduler_kv_cache_config 拍平喂调度器 / worker initialize_from_config 在 CuMem tag=kv_cache 池分配 / num_gpu_blocks·block_size·容量写回 cache_config
full-ISL 准入门：整序列预留 vs 只查第一 chunk 的超收漏洞（scheduler_reserve_full_isl 默认 True）——#39734 的第一半根治
回收感知准入上限 max_admission_blocks_per_request：cdiv(window−1+max_in_flight_tokens, bs)+1，启动池大小与运行准入单源（spec 方法）——预测器=分配器同构铁律（#39734 注释原文）
精修版水位 watermark：watermark_blocks=watermark×num_blocks，只对 WAITING/PREEMPTED 且本步已有调度请求保留 headroom——吞吐换稳定（默认 0 关；decode-heavy 抖动机理官方脚本论证）
SWA 窗外回收与 null_block 原位占位：get_num_skipped_tokens=max(0,computed−window+1) → 窗外整块 free 归池换 null，块表位置对齐不断裂（[NULL,NULL,block7,block8]）
kernel 块细分与多组块表：map_to_kernel_blocks（32-token 内存块拆 2×16 kernel 块，[0,1,2]→[0..5]）+ MultiGroupBlockTable 每组一表（后端协商内景 → ch21）
并发容量核算：max_concurrency = num_blocks / Σ_groups cdiv(每请求字节, page)（混合布局按组求和也正确）；kv_cache_size_tokens = 并发×max_model_len 写回 config 与日志
gpu_memory_utilization 语义与 profile 快照局限：per-instance 预算（默认 0.92，同卡多实例各设各的）；profile 是快照不是保证——其他进程显存变化被 assert 拒、真实负载峰可能超 dummy run，靠 util<1 留头寸
